# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and Skia m151 stability** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings Skia m151 stability fixes and sweeping performance improvements across HarfBuzz and color parsing. Hot paths in HarfBuzzSharp (UTF-8 encoding, Tag parsing), SKColor hex parsing, and SKShaper glyph reads are now allocation-free or zero-copy. WASM .NET 11 support arrives via Emscripten 5.0.6 with the new exception-handling ABI.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine was updated to m151, with multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges applied through the release cycle. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression fixed** — A regression in the CPU raster backend introduced by a recent Skia sync was resolved by restoring SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimised with ReadOnlySpan overloads** — The hex colour parser was rewritten to avoid allocations, and new ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads were added to SKColor.Parse and TryParse so callers can parse without converting to a string first. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))
- **HarfBuzzSharp hot paths are now allocation-free** — Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now encodes UTF-8 via a pooled buffer, eliminating per-call heap allocations. Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocate a char[4] per call. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396))
- **SKShaper glyph results via zero-copy spans** — SKShaper now reads glyph position results through spans directly into the output buffer, removing an intermediate array copy on every shaping call. ([#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed code** — The SKColor-to-SKColorF and SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply paths are now pure managed integer math, eliminating P/Invoke overhead on these frequently called conversions. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native handle was leaked when calling SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) with a non-null rect. The handle is now correctly released on both success and failure paths. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **WASM .NET 11 support via Emscripten 5.0.6** — Static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 and the new exnref exception-handling ABI are now included, enabling SkiaSharp to run on .NET 11 WebAssembly targets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free UTF-8 encoding in Buffer.AddUtf8 and zero-allocation Tag.Parse, making high-frequency text shaping calls significantly cheaper.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11 with the new exception-handling ABI, fixed the native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData, resolved a CPU raster regression, and applied final m151 stability merges.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Performance sprint: HarfBuzzSharp AddUtf8 and Tag.Parse became allocation-free, SKShaper adopted zero-copy spans, SKColor hex parsing was rewritten and gained Span overloads, and SKColor/SKPMColor conversions moved to managed math. Multiple m151 upstream syncs applied.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (July 2, 2026)

Upgraded to Skia m151, applied the initial submodule bump, and laid the groundwork for the performance sprint with early managed-port infrastructure.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.150.1...v4.151.0-preview.1.1)
